dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent circular and elliptical rings with high-contrast light-toned perimeters surrounding dark-toned centers; perimeters exhibit irregular, non-uniform pixel widths with sharp gradient transitions from the dark exterior into the light ring boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of asymmetrical, solid high-intensity white punctate clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the dorsal ridge and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most prominent mid-lateral annuli form an irregular convex polygon; a distinct scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of three isolated high-intensity blobs located on the anterior dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive interlocking figure-eight pattern formed by the fusion of two adjacent light-toned rings in the upper-mid lateral region.
